# Fallout 76 patch notes September 23, 2025 (Patch 62 bug fix)

![Fallout 76 patch notes September 23, 2025 (Patch 62 bug fix)](/uploads/561_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

## Patch Notes – 9/23/2025

The team fixed the following issues with an update:

- Improved stability on PlayStation 4 and 5.
- Wallpapers are now displayed correctly when players use the “Buildable” or “Unlocked Items” filters when building C.A.M.P.
- Fixed a bug that prevented wallpapers from appearing in the build menu for players using the Raider, Settler, or Future-Tec C.A.M.P. skins.
- Fixed a bug that caused the C.A.M.P. budget gauge to expand beyond its limit.

Source: betheda.net

Bethesda also lists all previous patch notes from September 2nd. back to the source. Feel free to watch it again if you want. Fallout 76 - Patch notes CAMP renovation / Patch 62 (09/02/2025)
